title: Nativ: Run frontier open models locally on your Mac
summary: Nativ is a tool that enables running frontier open-source AI models locally on Mac computers, likely leveraging Apple's Metal framework and MLX for optimized on-device inference. It provides a privacy-focused, offline-capable alternative to cloud-based AI services.
problem_solved: Enables running state-of-the-art open-source AI models locally on Mac without relying on cloud services.
why_valuable: Provides privacy, offline capability, and cost savings while running powerful AI models directly on personal hardware.
